metadata.name: spl_token_forwarder
metadata.description: SPL Token forwarder for wrap/unwrap operations with Ed25519 signature verification

instructions.name: close_config
docs: Close the config PDA; its rent goes to the committee. Call last.
Requires the adapter to be paused.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Emergency committee, receives the config's rent.

instructions.name: close_escrow
docs: Drain a mint's escrow to the recipient and close the escrow token
account; its rent goes to the committee. Requires the adapter to be
paused.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Emergency committee, receives the closed escrow ATA's rent.

instructions.name: close_nonce_bitmaps_batch
docs: Close the nonce bitmaps passed as remaining accounts; their rent goes
to the committee. Requires the adapter to be paused.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Emergency committee, receives the closed bitmaps' rent.

instructions.name: forward_call
docs: Forward a wrap or unwrap call from the Protocol Adapter.
Like the EVM V2 `ForwarderBaseUpgradeable.forwardCall()`, this does not check the
adapter's paused state: the adapter does not call forwarders while paused.

instructions.name: forward_emergency_call
docs: Withdraw from escrow while the adapter is paused, as the emergency
caller. The operand is an `UnwrapInput`. The EVM V1 forwarder's
forwardEmergencyCall(); V2 has no emergency path (anoma/dos-pm#86).

instructions.name: init_nonce_bitmap
docs: Create the nonce bitmap for one 256-nonce word of `user`, paid by
whoever signs. Permissionless: the bitmap holds nothing but used
bits, and a wrap requires it to exist. The adapter forwards no
signer to a forwarder, so the account cannot be created during the
wrap itself; a submitter sends this instruction ahead of settlement
when the word's bitmap is missing.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Initialize the forwarder config with emergency committee.
As the EVM V2 forwarder's initializer: no zero adapter or logic ref.
The committee, which has no V2 counterpart, must also be nonzero.

accounts.name: program
docs: The program account proves `program_data` is this program's own
ProgramData address rather than any account shaped like one.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: The loader records the upgrade authority here; it is the forwarder's owner.

instructions.name: reinitialize
docs: Rotate the logic ref, once per build that raises CONFIG_VERSION.
Mirrors the EVM forwarder's rotation: the owner upgrades the proxy to
an implementation whose `reinitializer(n)` writes the new ref
(`upgradeToAndCall`), and escrow and nonces stay. Here
the upgrade authority upgrades the program in place and then calls
this; it runs only while the config's version is below this build's.
Resources under the previous ref leave through the new one once the
kind table lists the previous version as its alias: a transaction
converts them, and the new resource unwraps.

accounts.name: program
docs: The program account proves `program_data` is this program's own
ProgramData address rather than any account shaped like one.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: The loader records the upgrade authority here; it is the forwarder's owner.

instructions.name: set_emergency_caller
docs: Set the emergency caller, once, by the committee while the adapter
is paused. The EVM V1 forwarder's setEmergencyCaller(); V2 has no
emergency path (anoma/dos-pm#86).

instructions.name: version
docs: The release this build is. Mirrors the EVM forwarder's `VERSION`:
read from the deployed program (by simulation), it names the code an
address runs, which an in-place upgrade changes.

types.name: Config
docs: Configuration account for the forwarder.
The adapter and logic ref mirror the EVM V2 forwarder's
`ForwarderBaseUpgradeable` state, and `version` its `Initializable`
version. The emergency committee and caller are the EVM V1 forwarder's
emergency mechanism, which V2 dropped (anoma/dos-pm#86).

fields.name: protocol_adapter
docs: The Protocol Adapter program ID that can call forward_call

fields.name: logic_ref
docs: The logic reference (verifying key) this forwarder handles

fields.name: emergency_committee
docs: Emergency committee that can set emergency_caller

fields.name: emergency_caller
docs: Emergency caller set by committee (zero = not set)

fields.name: version
docs: The version the config was last initialized at, as OpenZeppelin
Initializable's `_initialized`: `initialize` records CONFIG_VERSION,
and `reinitialize` raises it to CONFIG_VERSION once.

types.name: EmergencyCallerSet
docs: The EVM V1 forwarder's `event EmergencyCallerSet(address caller);` (V1 emergency mechanism, anoma/dos-pm#86).

types.name: Initialized
docs: Mirrors OpenZeppelin Initializable: `event Initialized(uint64 version);`

types.name: NonceBitmap
docs: One 256-nonce word of a user's wrap nonces (Permit2's bitmap pattern).
Seeds: ["nonce_bitmap", user, word_index_le_bytes]. Created by anyone
through `init_nonce_bitmap`, which pays its rent; a wrap only reads and
sets bits, so no signer reaches the forwarder through the adapter's CPI.

fields.name: bump
docs: The canonical bump of the bitmap's address, stored by `init_nonce_bitmap`.

types.name: Unwrapped
docs: Mirrors EVM: `event Unwrapped(address indexed token, address indexed to, uint128 amount);`

types.name: Wrapped
docs: Mirrors EVM: `event Wrapped(address indexed token, address indexed from, uint128 amount);`

constants.name: CONFIG_VERSION
docs: The config version this build initializes to and reinitializes to, as
the `n` of an OpenZeppelin `reinitializer(n)`. A build that rotates the
logic ref raises it by one, so its `reinitialize` runs once.

constants.name: ESCROW_SEED
docs: Seed of the escrow authority.

constants.name: NONCE_BITMAP_SEED
docs: Nonce bitmap PDA, one per user per 256-nonce word.
